reviewed_by: Codex focused review for durable research result callback retrieval
reason: The diff adds fixed result catalog, search, and read tools to callback turns and makes identical process result callbacks idempotent. Sixty-three selected Python cases cover command tool registration, retrieval validation, persisted callback handling, and automation runtime behavior. The callback browser journey checks the existing compact endpoint and resumed assistant activity on desktop and emulated mobile browsers. The real Core LAN reload check covers durable waiting-turn presentation after reconnect.
exclusions: No UI source, frontend unit behavior, or native Nebula code changed, so those layers are empty. Unrelated provider, workspace, and browser journeys and full suites are excluded. Browser tests use emulation; physical mobile-device testing is not claimed. The real Core test covers retained activity visibility, while the Python integration tests cover exact webhook replay and retrieval tool availability.
